named_visible_variable: Recording complete special-expression source pose only

reference_images.use: sole character identity, eye geometry, ink weight, and whitespace reference

reference_policy: Locked V9 is the sole visual reference. V17 detached accents, V10/V11, legacy art, rejected candidates, whole-face cards, and custom code art are forbidden prompt inputs, sources, or fallbacks.
source_component_contract: One complete centered V9 Companion face is required so the pose can later yield source-derived eye/highlight, brow, nose, mouth, cheek, and paired recording-ripple masks.
The open V9 eye silhouettes, white primary highlights, small fixed sparkles, eye spacing, nose anchor, and white background must remain the same character identity, not a new eye type.
The later runtime may compose only extracted masks; this source pose is never a runtime card or a flipbook frame.
prompt_delta: Generate one square white monochrome source-art image containing exactly one complete, centered V9 Companion recording-active special expression. It must be the same locked V9 character: keep the same pair of open rounded black eyes, the same white primary highlight and tiny fixed sparkle inside each eye, the same eye spacing and scale, the same small centered nose, the same cheek-dot placement, crisp black-on-white low-detail pixel-ink, and generous empty margins. Change only the expression into attentive listening/capture: the gaze is steady at center, the brows gather very gently in focused attention without anger, the tiny mouth is a compact calm listening curve, and one symmetric pair of small rounded listening ripples stays close to the outer sides of the face as an integrated recording-context detail. The face should feel present, concentrated, and warm, not alarmed, sleepy, romantic, playful, or generic UI. This is one complete special-expression source pose for later component extraction, not a UI screenshot and not an animation frame.
negative_constraints: no second face, contact sheet, grid, panel border, labels, letters, numbers, waveform, microphone icon, recording timer, device frame, body, ears, whiskers, or speech bubble
no changed eye shape, eyelids, pupils, different highlight grammar, asymmetrical eye identity, cat face, vector icon, emoji, or full-screen UI
no question mark, exclamation mark, heart, sparkle, moon, crescent, Z, arrow, checkmark, progress bar, color, grayscale, texture, shadow, gradient, or anti-aliased glossy vector treatment
no whole-face runtime playback, CEMP card rotation, legacy art, custom LUT, code-drawn face, V17 source, or daily-face fallback
